fields.source: Read on 25 Oct 2026 from the actors' public pages and their build README/input schema (api.apify.com/v2/acts/<id> and /builds/default, no key needed). NOT from a run: there is no Apify key on this Mac yet (SG15).

confirmed.apify/instagram-hashtag-scraper input: hashtags (array, with or without #, each one term), keywordSearch (bool), resultsType (posts | reels | stories, default posts), resultsLimit (integer, per hashtag; no maximum stated). No date filter, no sort: it returns recent posts or reels.
confirmed.apify/instagram-hashtag-scraper output (: inputUrl, id, type, shortCode, url, caption, hashtags, productType (clips), videoPlayCount, igPlayCount, likesCount, commentsCount, sharesCount, timestamp (ISO 8601), videoDuration, ownerUsername, musicInfo { artist_name, song_name, uses_original_audio, should_mute_audio, should_mute_audio_reason, audio_id }. An image post has a different musicInfo (audio_canonical_id, audio_type, music_info, original_sound_info) and no audio_id.
confirmed.apify/instagram-reel-scraper input: username (array: usernames, profile URLs, ids or reel URLs), resultsLimit (reels per profile), onlyPostsNewerThan (YYYY-MM-DD, ISO or '2 weeks'), skipPinnedPosts, skipTrialReels, includeSharesCount (paid), includeTranscript (add-on), includeDownloadedVideo (add-on)
confirmed.apify/instagram-reel-scraper output: the same reel fields as above plus videoViewCount; musicInfo as above
confirmed.memo23/instagram-audio-scraper input: trackIds (array of audio ids or instagram.com/reels/audio/<id>/ URLs), queries, postUrls, profileHandles, maxReelsPerProfile, datePosted, maxSoundsPerQuery, includeReelsUsingSound (paid plans only), maxReelsPerSound, saveAudio (paid)
confirmed.memo23/instagram-audio-scraper output (r: rowType, source, trackId, audioClusterId, title, artist (the creator's handle when isOriginalAudio), durationMs, isExplicit, isOriginalAudio, hasLyrics, isTrending, trendRank, coverArtworkUrl, audioDownloadUrl, previewUrl, totalReelsUsingSound, scrapedAt. A track-id lookup always fills totalReelsUsingSound and isTrending (is_trending_in_clips); a catalogue search row does not send isTrending.
confirmed.prices (free tier): hashtag scraper $0.0026 per result; reel scraper $0.006 per start + $0.0026 per reel; audio scraper $0.004 per sound (+ $0.0001 per GB of memory per start)

notConfirmed: That resultsType 'reels' items carry videoPlayCount (the page's sample is a reel found in posts mode).
The order of the hashtag scraper's results and how many it returns per hashtag for a big hashtag.
Whether trendRank is lower-is-better (the page only says 'Instagram's clip trend rank when present').
What the audio scraper returns for a sound id that Instagram has retired (an error row {source, error, message, errorKind} is documented and is not billed).
The real cost of a run (the run-sync endpoint gives no run id or cost in its response headers, so the pick logs an estimate).

song-as-sound.note: Hashtag-scraper style reels (C76). The first two are hit songs uploaded as sounds by another account (SG13's real examples: the artist field is the uploader, the title reads 'Song - Artist' or 'Song • Artist', and the actor's flag says original); the third is a creator's own named sound.
